title: Hierarchical abstractions as a basis for ontology graphs
summary: Formalized contextual abstraction domains, task-relative sufficiency, typed polyhierarchies and claim admission. Added proofs of composition/separation and counterexamples for summary loss and inconsistent distributed merges.
